annotations.text: Auth: Cognito-backed login/signup, JWT bearer on API calls. Signup requires an invite code.
Responsive: 2-col workout grid collapses to 1 column under ~640px; top nav collapses to a hamburger menu.
Two workout modes drive two detail layouts: Isotonic (sets x reps, forest green accent) vs Mobeta (seconds held, amber accent). Metric cards stack vertically on mobile.
All charts (card thumbnails included) share one XYChart abstraction (day-volume, day-intensity, day-metric, second-metric) - same styling, different x/y bindings.
Entry forms mirror the mode split: rep/weight rows for Isotonic, a seconds timer for Mobeta.
